name: 嗯嗯收到
caption: 收到！
action: The character nods eagerly in a crisp repeated rhythm like a happy bobblehead. The large head dips forward and springs upright, with bright open eyes and a sweet closed-mouth smile. The little body stays planted, arms relaxed separately beside the torso. Bangs flop and rebound while long hair and costume edges follow with a soft delay. Each nod has a tiny anticipation and soft overshoot, repeating evenly in the same place.

name: 好耶蹦蹦
caption: 好耶！
action: The character repeatedly makes small delighted hops in place. Bent knees compress softly before every springy lift, both tiny fists held separately beside the shoulders. A joyful open smile and crescent-shaped happy eyes stay consistent. The head and body rise together, feet landing in the same small area with a soft squash. Hair and loose fabric float a beat behind the jump and settle with each landing. The bouncy rhythm remains continuous and playful.

name: 害羞贴贴
caption: 诶嘿…
action: The character holds two little palms gently against the rosy cheeks, hands staying clearly separate on either side of the face. The shoulders rise and sink in a bashful little scrunch, the knees bending slightly inward. Open eyes glance shyly aside with a tiny embarrassed smile. The body makes a very small soft sway, while hair tips and ribbons follow with a delayed flutter. Keep the cheek color constant and the affectionate pose intact throughout the repeating motion.

name: 委屈巴巴
caption: 呜呜
action: The character wears an exaggerated tiny wobbly pout, eyebrows sloping upward and large glossy eyes brimming with tears that never fall. The little fists remain separately beside the body. Small rhythmic sniffling hitches lift and release the shoulders, creating a gentle trembling bounce in the cheeks. Hair tips and loose costume edges quiver sympathetically. The tears remain pooled at a constant level and the plaintive expression stays readable through the soft repeating sniffles.

name: 气鼓鼓
caption: 哼！
action: The character keeps round puffed cheeks and adorably determined eyebrows while stomping the little feet alternately in place. Both arms are held down and slightly away from the body like tiny wings. Each compact stomp gives the head and cheeks a punchy soft bob, without moving the character across the floor. Hair and loose sleeves bounce with delayed follow-through. The angry bun-like face stays consistent, making the whole repeated tantrum cute and harmless.

name: 困困点点
caption: 困了
action: The character sways sleepily with heavy half-lidded eyes and a tiny relaxed mouth. The large head gently droops forward and lifts through a slow drowsy breathing cycle, while the short arms hang loosely at the sides. Knees soften slightly and recover without taking a step. Hair tips and cloth settle almost weightlessly with the breathing. Keep the posture soft, the eyelids consistent and the movement unhurried, like a small sleepy doll continually trying to stay upright.

name: 开心摇摇乐
caption: 摇起来～
action: The character dances from side to side in place with an irresistibly buoyant alternating knee bounce. The head and torso tilt together left and right, while two tiny fists bob separately at chest height. A cheerful open-eyed smile stays bright. The feet shift weight within the same small area without travelling. Long hair, ribbon tails and loose sleeves lag behind each change of direction with a soft elastic swing, sustaining a clear, playful, endlessly repeating dance rhythm.

name: 嗨嗨挥手
caption: 我来啦
action: The character waves to the viewer with the arm on the viewer's left, making a smooth repeated side-to-side arc with one simple mitten-shaped hand. The other arm stays relaxed at the side. Bright open eyes and a friendly smile remain visible. The torso gives a small counter-bounce with each wave, while the feet stay planted. Hair swings gently with a slight delay and the costume edges flutter. Keep the waving hand away from the face and head ornament.

name: 拜托拜托
caption: 拜托啦
action: The character gazes hopefully at the viewer with huge sparkling eyes and a tiny pleading smile. Two rounded hands rest together neatly below the chin, staying in one simple prayer-like shape. The whole body rises and falls in quick tiny tiptoe bobs, leaning forward only slightly without approaching the camera. Hair and fabric bounce lightly with delayed follow-through. Preserve the eye colors, keep the hands stable, and repeat the eager elastic bounce with an affectionate expectant expression.

name: 得意叉腰
caption: 我超棒
action: The character stands with both hands resting firmly on the hips, elbows clearly visible at the sides, chin slightly lifted and a tiny smug smile. A slow proud tiptoe rise gives the whole silhouette a soft upward bounce, followed by a gentle settling of the knees. The eyes stay playfully half-lidded. Hair and loose cloth lift outward and fall with a slight lag. Keep the outfit, hands-on-hips pose and mischievous expression consistent as the confident little bounce repeats.
